newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust buys NationsBank trust business.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust buys NationsBank trust business.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp. said on Friday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire NationsBank's institutional trust business, which has $1.33 billion in assets, in a move that boosts Bankers Trust's assets under custody to nearly $2 trillion.
Terms were not disclosed, but Bankers Trust said the deal would have no material effect on its earnings.
NationsBank Corp. said it was selling the 465 master trust and custody accounts to focus on its investment and investment-related businesses.

Bankers Trust Chairman Frank Newman said in a statement that the acquisition "fits our goal of expanding our institutional trust business and will allow us to further leverage our technology and custody infrastructure."
The deal, still subject to regulatory approval, was expected to be completed before July.
Bankers Trust said it planned to open additional offices in such cities as Dallas, St. Louis and Kansas City to serve some of its newly acquired clients.

"This continues our stated strategy of expanding our presence across the United States, begun last year with the addition of personnel to our Chicago and San Francisco offices," said Timothy Keaney, head of Bankers Trust's global retirement services.
